description: Delete a machine by id (GUID) or exact serial number, as the machines screen does. A machine with an operation running on it cannot be deleted: finish the operation first. Unfinished operations assigned to it lose the machine; the preview lists them. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

machine.description: The machine to delete: its id (GUID) or its exact serial number.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: delete_machine
title: Delete Machine
